title: Extract ratings, templates and core project CRUD
statusScope: PRJ-03 complete for ratings, templates and core CRUD (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /projects, GET /projects/:id). routes/ai-actions.ts is deliberately untouched (undecided, recorded). Typecheck, build and tests ran in a scratch copy installed with --no-frozen-lockfile; the repo's own frozen install still fails. DB-backed tests did not run, and parity was shown against fake databases. Two pre-existing issues were found and preserved, not fixed (see findings).

behaviorPreserved: All 47 route paths, methods, middleware chains and registration order unchanged (frozen surface check passes).
Rating validation keeps Number() coercion (true counts as 1, '5' as 5); average rounding and distribution unchanged.
The projects_updated broadcast still fires after the write and before the response.
Handlers that had no try/catch (all rating routes except the list, and all template routes except create, patch and from-project) still have none.
Template create/patch/from-project still map the unique-name violation to 409 and rethrow anything else; the clear-previous-default-then-write transactions are unchanged and still roll back together.
Templates still never create or update a project.
Generated raw SQL text is identical to the original for every CRUD scenario, including the unescaped deadline/startedAt fragments.
Side effects keep their order: write, broadcast, best-effort Telegram alert (create), then the response; delete still fires the sync cascade without awaiting it.
PATCH keeps its try/catch and 500 body; GET list, GET detail, POST and DELETE keep having none.
ai-actions.ts and its project insert are untouched.

findings.summary: POST /projects (deadline) and PATCH /projects/:id (deadline, startedAt) interpolate request values into raw SQL without escaping. Preserved and pinned by a characterization test; needs its own approved change.

findings.severity: likely functional bug, NOT confirmed on a real database
findings.summary: POST /projects calls formatProject on a raw snake_case row whenever the body carries a raw-SQL-only field; createdAt would be undefined and the handler would throw after the insert and broadcast, returning 500 for a created project. Reproduced against the original handler with a snake_case fake only.
